info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Webhook By Event Id-spec
info.description: The Manage Webhook Subscriptions API allows users to efficiently remove specific webhook events linked to a given subscription. By targeting a particular webhook and event ID, consumers can ensure that unwanted notifications are disabled, maintaining streamlined communication. This API is particularly beneficial for developers managing integrations that require controlled webhook event management. Typical use cases include adjusting webhook configurations based on changing application states or user preferences.

delete.summary: Delete a specific event from a webhook.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a specific event associated with the webhook identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the event you wish to delete is no longer required as this action is irreversible.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details needed for the deletion of the event associated with the given webhook. It must adhere to the defined schema and include all necessary parameters for successful deletion.

204.description: Request completed successfully; no content returned.

DeleteWebhookByEventIdRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the DELETE operation on the specified webhook event.

DeleteWebhookByEventIdResponse_204.description: A confirmation message indicating that a DELETE operation was successful. This response is returned with no content.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses Bearer authentication with a JSON Web Token (JWT). You must include a valid JWT in the Authorization header to access protected resources.
